newsitem.title: UK: British Aerospace up on UK Eurofighter order.
newsitem.headline: British Aerospace up on UK Eurofighter order.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace rose 9p to 1005-1/2p by 1047 GMT as British Defence Minister Michael Portillo said Britain is prepared to buy 232 Eurofighter 2000 fighter aircraft.
The announcement was made at the start of Britain's Farnborough air show.

The Eurofighter consortium of British Aerospace, Daimler Aerospace, Italy's Alenia and Casa of Spain, wants a firm memorandum of understanding from their governments to buy the plane at the end of the year so it can set up production lines for the estimated 620 aircraft required.
